page.overview:
Who is Kakunoshin?

Kakunoshin is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

Kakunoshin is an adult man of average height with short, light brown hair, thick eyebrows, and long sideburns. He wears a blue with a light blue diamond design on its collar and a yellow sash, as well as a dark blue overcoat.

It is implied he has an ankle tattoo of a reverse crescent moon, symbolizing his alliance to the Kouzuki Family. In the anime, this tattoo is explicitly shown.

Kakunoshin is loyal to the Kouzuki Family, and was willing to join their resistance immediately. He shows a particular dislike of Kurozumi Orochi, and wanted revenge against him personally.
